verdict.rationale: Moneybird is accounting software, so AP aging and vendor balances are a fair question. The evidence pack only covers authentication, the contacts API, invoicing, payments, sandboxes and API versioning. Nothing documents purchase-invoice aging reports or point-in-time vendor balances, and contact lookup is not a balance or aging capability.

support.subject: As an accountant, I can see accounts payable aging and vendor balances at any point in time
